skill.name: deliverability-qa
skill.description: Checks email deliverability readiness before a send using DNS authentication, DMARC RUA evidence, reputation data, seed-list results, content risk, and list hygiene. Produces SEND-S scoring, S1 status, and practical fixes without computing the final Email Quality Score.
skill.summary: Run a one-time email deliverability preflight with SEND-S scoring and S1 authentication status.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are false positives from Markdown backticks, relative documentation links, repository URLs, and deliverability terminology. The optional Python connector commands and RESEND_API_KEY are real risk surfaces because they execute local scripts and handle credentials. No evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or malicious business logic was found.

remediation.suggestion: Document the exact reviewed connector scripts, validate domain and selector arguments, and require confirmation before running Python helpers.
Require a least-privilege RESEND_API_KEY, never print it, and explain where the connector sends requests.

remediation.issue: Relative links trigger path traversal scanners
remediation.suggestion: Keep repository-relative links, but document that they are references, not file operations.

content.value_statement: Email teams need evidence before sending, but deliverability data is spread across DNS, ESP, reputation, and seed-test tools. This skill turns those inputs into a clear SEND-S preflight, S1 status, and fix list.
actual_capabilities: Checks SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and BIMI evidence from DNS exports and DMARC RUA reports.
Reviews sender domain and IP reputation using ESP reports, Google Postmaster Tools, or Microsoft SNDS data.
Interprets seed-list inbox placement results across inbox, spam, and promotions tabs.
Scans campaign HTML for risky phrases, broken links, missing plain text, and render issues.
Scores the SEND-S dimension and flags S1 as pass, partial, veto-candidate, or needs input.
limitations: Does not compute the final Email Quality Score or enforce vetoes.
Requires user-supplied DNS, DMARC, ESP, reputation, and seed-test evidence.
Cannot prove real traffic alignment without a DMARC RUA report.
Does not monitor recurring bounce or complaint trends over time.

use_cases.title: Check a Launch Send
use_cases.description: Verify authentication, reputation, inbox placement, and list hygiene before a promotional campaign.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Spam Placement
use_cases.description: Use seed-test and ESP evidence to identify why a sending domain reaches spam or promotions tabs.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Findings
use_cases.description: Create a structured deliverability checklist with pass, partial, fail, and needs-input notes.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Preflight
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check before a single send
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a deliverability preflight for my sending domain before this newsletter. I have DNS records, a DMARC RUA report, and seed-test results.

prompt_templates.title: Authentication Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of authentication and hygiene
prompt_templates.prompt: Check SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, inbox placement, and bounce metrics for my domain. Mark each item pass, partial, fail, or needs input.

prompt_templates.title: SEND-S Score
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced scoring for a specific campaign goal
prompt_templates.prompt: Score SEND-S for a cold outbound program using my ESP export, Postmaster data, DMARC RUA report, seed-list test, and campaign HTML.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Domain Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit multiple sending domains for S1 readiness. Compare authentication alignment, reputation, complaint rates, inbox placement, and unresolved fixes by domain.

output_examples.input: Preflight for a retention newsletter with DMARC and seed-list data.
output: S1 is partial because DMARC is present at p=none and SPF plus DKIM align.
Inbox placement is acceptable, but Gmail promotions placement needs monitoring.
Fix one broken footer link and collect the missing complaint-rate export.

output_examples.input: Spam placement diagnosis for a new outbound domain.
output: Authentication is a veto-candidate because no DMARC record was found.
Reputation is needs input because Postmaster or SNDS evidence is missing.
Do not send until DMARC exists and the auditor reviews S1.

output_examples.input: Client checklist for a promotional campaign.
output: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC pass with aligned identifiers.
Content scan flags a shortened link and no plain-text part.
SEND-S is ready after the link and plain-text fixes are confirmed.

best_practices: Provide fresh DMARC RUA and seed-list evidence for the same sending domain.
Separate one-time preflight evidence from recurring trend monitoring.
Ask before saving results to memory or sharing them with another workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not treat missing DMARC RUA data as a pass.
Do not use the skill to approve purchased or scraped lists.
Do not ask it to compute the final EQS or enforce vetoes.

faq.question: What evidence should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide DNS records, a DMARC RUA report, ESP deliverability data, reputation data, seed-test results, and campaign HTML.

faq.question: Does this skill approve a send?
faq.answer: No. It scores SEND-S and flags S1. The email-quality-auditor decides final EQS and veto outcomes.

faq.question: Can it work without a DMARC RUA report?
faq.answer: It can review setup records, but real traffic alignment remains needs input without DMARC RUA evidence.

faq.question: Does it monitor deliverability over time?
faq.answer: No. It is a one-time pre-send snapshot, not a recurring bounce or complaint trend monitor.

faq.question: Can it check content risk?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews spam-trigger phrasing, image balance, links, plain-text presence, and rendering issues.

faq.question: Does it need API access?
faq.answer: No API is required. Optional connectors can use account exports or a least-privilege Resend key.
